title: prefixcache-occupancy-surge-safeguards-and-fragmentation-mitigation
creator: Asha Patel
summary: Production surge where prefix cache occupancy estimator overreacted during autoscaling, triggering eviction storms and slab fragmentation which resulted in increased latency and several soft OOM node restarts.
impact: Between 2026-02-18 02:13 UTC and 2026-02-18 03:07 UTC we observed a 4x tail latency increase on text-generation endpoints for 3 mid-tier customers and 5 transient node restarts attributed to memory fragmentation. Approx 0.2% of requests returned 5xx errors during the window.
timeline: 2026-02-18 02:10 UTC - autoscale event started for a tenant; 02:13 - alerts: prefixcache eviction rate spike; 02:20 - ops muted noisy alerts and routed traffic to fallback model variant; 02:35 - mitigations applied (manual eviction-throttle and shard pinning); 03:05 - rolling restart of two affected nodes; 03:07 - system stabilized, eviction rates returned to baseline.
root_cause: A change in the eviction scoring heuristic (merge in runtime-1.20, PR #4213) adjusted occupancy weighting and introduced a non-linear response for small shard occupancy variance. Under autoscale churn the estimator overshot, marking many entries as high-priority for eviction simultaneously which caused hot eviction storms and repeated allocations that fragmented slab allocators. The fragmentation amplified resident set growth and pushed kernels into frequent GC/restart cycles.
short_term_mitigations: 1) Reverted the occupancy weighting change to the previous stable heuristic (hotfix runtime-1.20.1, PR #4228). 2) Added a temporary per-shard eviction-rate cap (config flag: evict_rate_cap=1000/s). 3) Pinned warmed shards for critical tenants to prevent mass simultaneous eviction during autoscale. 4) Adjusted autoscaler cooldown from 60s -> 180s for affected cluster pool.
long_term_action_items: 1) Rework occupancy estimator to include hysteresis and rate-limited reactions (owner: Liam). 2) Implement slab defragmentation scanner that runs during low-load windows and compacts free spans (owner: Priya Rao). 3) Add a cross-shard correlation detector that triggers soft-fallback instead of mass-eviction when multiple shards spike concurrently (owner: Marco). 4) Add telemetry: per-shard eviction_score histogram, slab-fragmentation_ratio metric, and eviction-backpressure events (owner: Observability). 5) Backfill load tests that simulate autoscale churn at 10k qps for 24h in perf lab before graduation (owner: SRE).
tradeoffs_and_decisions: We chose a conservative revert + short-term caps to restore production stability quickly rather than an invasive refactor during the incident. Tradeoff: temporary increase in steady-state memory usage vs near-term risk reduction. For long-term, we prioritized a design that prevents simultaneous eviction decisions across shards rather than only tuning thresholds to minimize repeat regressions.

acceptance_criteria: 1) New occupancy estimator validated in perf lab with autoscale-churn test (no eviction storms across 10 runs). 2) Slab compactor reduces fragmentation_ratio below 15% in staging. 3) Eviction_score_histogram and slab metrics are visible in prod dashboards and generate an automated paging alert when thresholds exceeded.
risks: Complexity of compactor could impact p99 latency if run during peak; mitigation is to run only in low-util windows and provide an opt-out flag per-cluster. There's also a risk that hysteresis delays eviction enough to temporarily increase memory pressure—load tests must validate safe headroom.
next_steps: 1) Sprint assignment: implement occupancy hysteresis (Liam) and correlation detector sketch (Marco) in Sprint 25. 2) Priya to finish compactor unit tests by 2026-03-12 and schedule staging rollout. 3) Observability to promote metrics to prod and create runbook entries by 2026-03-08.
notes: This incident exposed a class of failure where algorithmic changes that look stable in synthetic unit tests can interact poorly with autoscaler dynamics. Action: require autoscale-churn scenario in the acceptance matrix for any cache/eviction heuristic change.
